sources.snippet: so101-pi05-base Physical Intelligence's pi0.5 vision-language-action model, fully fine-tuned on a unified corpus of public SO-101 / SO-100 single-arm manipulation data. This package holds the model card, the dataset card, the scripts that built the dataset, the training container, and the documentation needed to repeat the work.
